verdict.rationale: TaxJar is API-first, so it can run without a UI: token-based API key auth, official clients in seven languages, and a dedicated sandbox endpoint suitable for automated test runs. Calculations, transaction uploads, nexus and address validation can all be scripted. Missing for 10: no official CLI, no CI-specific docs or examples, no published OpenAPI spec (probe 404), and no independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
